associations.rationale: For an indecomposable finite-dimensional module over an arbitrary field, the type directly gives the required invertible-or-nilpotent endomorphism alternative underlying Lemma 3.8.2.
The type directly asserts existence of a finite independent supremum decomposition into indecomposable submodules over an arbitrary field.
The type directly states Krull-Schmidt uniqueness: two indecomposable direct-sum decompositions have equal length and matching isomorphic summands.
The type only proves that a finite sum of nilpotent endomorphisms is nilpotent, a helper for the requested theorem rather than the theorem itself.
